about_short_description.short_description: The visual note-taking tool for learning complex topics.

product.name: Heptabase Visual Note-Taking Platform
product.description: A software platform that enables users to organize and visualize notes using whiteboards, mindmaps, tables, and kanban boards for learning and research purposes.

product.name: Heptabase Multi-Format Note Integration
product.description: A feature that allows users to highlight and annotate PDFs, transcribe audio and video content, and manage notes and journals within the platform.

product.name: Heptabase Collaborative Research Whiteboards
product.description: A collaborative feature that allows multiple users to work together on research projects using shared whiteboards with offline accessibility.
